_comment: The live sale, as data. scripts/verify-prices.mjs renders this into README.md between the SALE markers and REMOVES it once `end` passes. Set `sale` to null when nothing is running. `codes` may be empty; `beatsEveryday: false` swaps the stock stacking line for `compare`. Write these strings the way you'd tell a friend: say the deal, the price, who should skip it, then stop. No narrating the announcement, no explaining the automation.

sale.name: Back to School sale
sale.headline: 35% off certifications with `SEPT26BTS35`, or 40% off bundles and instructor-led training with `SEPT26BTS40`
sale.bannerAlt: Linux Foundation Back to School sale, ends September 22: up to 40% off training and certifications
sale.compare: This one actually beats `RUSHABH30`: 35% against 30%, on every exam in the table below. The codes don't stack, so use the sale code until September 22 and `RUSHABH30` after that.

bundles.label: KCNA, KCSA, PCA, OTCA, LFCA and the other associate exams: ~~$250~~ **$163**

sale.dateCaveat: Runs until 11:59 PM Eastern on September 22, which is 9:29 AM IST on the 23rd. New and individual purchases only, not renewals. Does not apply to THRIVE-ONE subscriptions or any FinOps certification.
